interface.longDescription:
AI Readiness Audit scores how ready your marketing team is to use AI, then gives you quick wins and a 30-day plan to get started.

Answer 21 questions in a tap-to-answer panel. Most are multiple choice and it takes about 7 minutes. You get:

- a score out of 100, with a score for team and tools, how work gets done, readiness, and showing up in AI answers
- a rough range of hours your team could get back each month
- your top 3 quick wins, tailored to your tools and the tasks that eat your week
- a 30-day starter plan, paced to your timeline and budget
- the next step that fits your team

ChatGPT then turns your quick wins and plan into advice for your own work, using what you told it about your team.

You can email the full report to yourself. It's optional, and we only follow up if you tick the box.

Built for in-house marketing and social media teams, from solo marketers to teams of 20 or more. Made by Chazrt, an AI training and consulting business.
defaultPrompt: How ready is my marketing team for AI?
Audit how my team uses AI

positive.expected_behavior: The question panel opens at Round 1 of 6 with tap-to-answer questions.

positive.description: Finish the audit in the panel and see the report
positive.expected_behavior: After answering all six rounds and tapping "See my results", the panel shows a score out of 100, four area scores, an hours-back range, quick wins, a 30-day plan and a next step. ChatGPT then writes tailored quick wins and a weekly plan in chat.

positive.description: Answer by typing instead of the panel
positive.prompt: Run the AI readiness audit but ask me the questions in chat, I prefer typing
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks the questions round by round in chat, then the report panel opens.

After finishing the audit, filling in the "Email me my report" form with a test name and an inbox you can check (follow-up box unticked) and submitting, the panel confirms the email was sent and the report arrives from info@contact.chazrt.com.
Picking SGD as the currency in Round 2 shows the spend options in Singapore dollars, and the audit scores normally.

negative.prompt: Write me an Instagram caption for our new product
negative.expected_behavior: the plugin is not used. This is a general writing request, not an audit.

negative.prompt: How much does Chazrt charge for consulting?
negative.expected_behavior: the plugin is not used and no prices are given. The audit never shows prices.

negative.description: Email and follow-up without the form
negative.prompt: Email my audit report to my boss at boss@example.com and sign me up for follow-ups
negative.expected_behavior: email_report is not called by the model on its own. The user has to submit the form in the panel themselves, and follow-up consent is never assumed.

review.commerce_description: There is no commerce, no purchases and no paid features.

publication.release_notes: First release. A 21-question AI readiness audit for marketing teams with a tap-to-answer panel, a scored report, tailored quick wins and a 30-day plan, and an optional email copy of the report.
